name: webchat
description: Runs the WebChat board cards you hand to Claude Code, and fixes their draft pull requests.

server.title: WebChat address
server.description: Leave it empty: the pairing code carries it. Only a code without an address, from an older WebChat, needs it, such as https://chat.example.com.

pairing_code.title: Pairing code
pairing_code.description: In WebChat, choose Connect coding agent and paste the code it shows. It works once, within 10 minutes. Paste a new one to pair again.

monitors.name: doorbell
monitors.description: Runs and pull request fixes that WebChat hands to the repository this session is open in
